title: A worker dies in the middle of a step
design_ref: Steps, history and replay; Failure modes
purpose: Kill, with no warning, the worker that is running a long step. Another worker must take the run over, the finished steps must not be paid for again, and then take away every worker at once.

checks.description: the test step is running on a worker, in flight
checks.because: The engine tracks which worker last reported on each pending activity.

checks.description: the run carried on to the review step on another worker, with nobody touching it
checks.because: The engine noticed the activity's heartbeat had stopped, and scheduled it again for another worker.

checks.description: the interrupted step shows a second attempt in the history
checks.because: The history records which attempt finally completed, and why the earlier one failed.

checks.description: no model call was repeated: one call for each of steps 0 to 6
checks.because: Replay returns the recorded answer for every step that finished. Only the unfinished tool step ran again.

checks.description: with no worker running, the run still exists in the engine
checks.because: The run is a row of history in PostgreSQL, not a process.

checks.description: two brand-new workers took the run over and carried it to the review step
checks.because: Any worker can continue any run: nothing the run needed was in the workers that were removed.

checks.description: the model was still called exactly once per step for that run
checks.because: The new workers replayed the history without calling the model.
